# ChatbotLite

> Drop-in AI chatbot for any website. A React widget plus a server-side ChatBot client, published on npm as `chatbotlite`. Three lines to add chat: a widget, a `/api/chat` SSE route, and a markdown knowledge file. 10 LLM providers with auto-failover, 13 URL-only payment/scheduling adapters, no vector DB. Apache-2.0, BYOK.
